context: 5. Monitor recovery Watch queue decrease: watch 'curl https://api.firstuk.bank/pps/queue-length'

description: Monitoring queue recovery is followed by escalation to database team if recovery is not improving
context: 6. If not improving Escalate to database team (see Step 6)
